sightings.title: How to advertise house for rent nigeria

brief.reason: This topic addresses how landlords and agents can effectively market rental properties, a core aspect of tenancy.
brief.working_title: How to Advertise a House for Rent in Nigeria: Tips for Landlords & Agents
brief.the_question: How can landlords and agents effectively advertise rental properties and write engaging captions in Nigeria?
brief.angle: This page will focus on legally compliant advertising practices and ethical considerations for landlords and agents, ensuring adverts meet Nigerian tenancy law standards.
verify: Lagos State Tenancy Law, 2011 (or relevant state tenancy law) - sections on landlord obligations
Advertising Practitioners (Registration, etc.) Act, 2004 - provisions on advertising standards and ethics
Consumer Protection Act - sections on misleading advertisements or unfair practices
Estate Agency best practices for property listings in Nigeria
Standard requirements for property descriptions and disclosures

decision.reason: Read against the law shelf and the Growth lock (4 Nov 2026: a page only where DocOga writes the document). The question is listing marketing; the only law behind it is agent registration (Lagos LASRERA Law 2021), misleading-advertisement rules (FCCPA 2018, Part XV) and the advertising regulator's code — none of which a tenancy document carries. No DocOga document stands behind a listing page, so no page. LATER: a landlord's letter of authority to let (landlord → agent, naming the fee and the LASRERA number) would give the question a document; revisit if the field asks a third time or the Lagos Bill's 5% agency cap becomes law.
